question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about angiosperms?

options.text: These are also called flowering plants.
Double fertilisation is a characteristic of angiosperms.

solution:
The Correct Answer is** __Option 3.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Angiosperms 

__
 
• Angiosperms are vascular plants.
 
• They have stems, roots, and leaves.
 
• Angiosperms are also known as “**flowering plants**” because flowers are a characteristic part of their reproductive structure.
 
• **Double fertilisation** is a characteristic of angiosperms.
 
• Angiosperm's seeds are found in a flower. These plants have covered seeds.
 
• Angiosperm eggs are fertilized and develop into a seed in an ovary that is usually in a flower.
 
• The flowers of angiosperms have male or female reproductive organs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The gymnosperms, also known as Acrogymnospermae, are a group of seed-producing plants.
 
• It includes conifers, cycads, Ginkgo, and gnetophyte.
